matches.rationale: The ground truth describes an unspecified logical flaw in the proof of Theorem 5.1 (corrected in a later erratum), and Theorem 5.1's proof occupies Section 5. Findings 7, 9, 10, and 11 each identify distinct logical gaps or inconsistencies within that same Section 5 proof (an absurd decomposition-group claim, an unjustified finiteness/Euler-characteristic assumption, an inverted formula, and a misapplication of Corollary 2.17), any of which plausibly corresponds to the flaw that invalidates the theorem's proof.
